query: NVIDIA Data Center segment definition fiscal 2026
normalized: 2026 center data definition fiscal nvidia segment

output.content:
NVIDIA defines **Data Center** as a market platform—not one of its reportable operating segments; its two operating segments are **Compute & Networking** and **Graphics**. [[1]] 

In fiscal 2026, the Data Center platform targeted compute-intensive AI, data processing, graphics, robotics, and scientific-computing workloads across cloud, hyperscale, on-premises, and edge data centers. [[2]] It comprised data-center compute and networking infrastructure—typically supplied as rack-scale systems, subsystems, or modules—plus software and services. [[2]] 

Its networking scope includes NVLink interconnects and switches; InfiniBand and Ethernet platforms; network adapters, cables, DPUs, switch chips and systems; and related software. [[2]]
